mission_06: ADASYN (Adaptive Synthetic Sampling) is an advanced oversampling technique that improves upon SMOTE by focusing on hard-to-learn minority class samples. While SMOTE generates the same number of synthetic samples for all minority instances, ADASYN adaptively adjusts the number of synthetic samples based on the density distribution. Minority samples that are harder to learn (surrounded by majority class neighbors) receive more synthetic samples. This adaptive approach often leads to better classification performance on imbalanced datasets. In this mission, you will apply ADASYN and compare its behavior with SMOTE.
